artifacts.synopsis: Complainants challenged Philadelphia Presbytery's disposition of indictments arising from the division of Christ Reformed Presbyterian Church, Oreland. The commission sustained the principal specifications, annulled Presbytery's adoption of its judicial commission report, tried the matters de novo, and imposed censures on ministers and former ruling elders.
